name: Indonesia
description: Indonesia from the first humans of Java to Srivijaya, Majapahit, the spice trade, Dutch rule, independence and the world's largest island nation.

checkpoints.name: Early islands
checkpoints.note: Early humans lived on Java more than a million years ago. Rice growers and seafarers settled the islands, and the Buddhist empire of Srivijaya and the builders of Borobudur flourished.

checkpoints.name: Kingdoms and spice
checkpoints.note: Majapahit ruled the islands from Java, and Islam spread along the trade routes. The Dutch East India Company seized the spice trade and made Batavia its base.

checkpoints.name: Dutch Indies
checkpoints.note: The Dutch state took over the colony and forced farmers to grow crops for export. Krakatoa exploded in 1883, and a national movement grew in the 1900s.

checkpoints.name: Independent Indonesia
checkpoints.note: Sukarno declared independence in 1945. Suharto's army took power after the killings of 1965 and ruled until 1998, when democracy returned.
